title: Multiply fractions
status: draft: written by Claude, waiting for owner review
about: Teacher-verified mastery check. Written separately from the practice generators: different wordings, word problems, and a reasoning item. Each item is worth 1 point. 'math' is the calculation behind the item, used only by the test that checks the answer key.
directions: Show your work. Write every answer in simplest form.

items.prompt: A garden is {3/4} of a meter long and {2/3} of a meter wide. What is its area, in square meters?
Without multiplying, is {4/5} × {7/8} more or less than {4/5}? Explain how you know.
items.answer: less (multiplying by 7/8, less than 1, gives less)

items.prompt: A recipe needs {3/4} cup of sugar. You are making {1/2} of the recipe. How much sugar do you need?
Without multiplying, is 6 × {2/3} more or less than 6? Explain how you know.
items.answer: less (two thirds of 6 is less than all of 6)
